correctness.rationale: The pair-connection probability for arcs at cyclic distance d is exactly q^d+q^(4-d)-q^4 by edge-disjoint paths; the uniform-seed expected size is the weighted connectivity quadratic form. Exact eigenvalues (1+2q+2q^2+2q^3-3q^4), (1-q^2)^2 twice, and (1-q)^2(1+q^2) diagonalize it. The positive eigenvalue separation 2q(1-q)^2, integer parities and positivity of the four arc lengths yield all four unique equality classes up to dihedral symmetry and exact penalty. A dependency-free checker exhausts every ordered integer composition through total ten at q=2/5, and all optimizers for n=4..16 at three additional q values. Finite enumeration is only corroboration.

value.rationale: Four weak links are the first cycle size permitting inequivalent adjacent-versus-opposite arrangements of the two larger balanced arcs. The theorem completely classifies containment-optimal layouts for every cycle length and every intermediate barrier success probability, and quantifies the universal exact nonzero orientation penalty; it is a natural stochastic design benchmark rather than a one-off calculation. Relevance is limited to one-dimensional uniform-seed independent-edge spread with certain intra-arc transmission.
